name: Vanillite (Simple)
author: hthoene@users.noreply.github.com
description: Vanillite: a Minecraft Java Edition server that plays exactly like the official one, but is faster and needs less memory. This egg shows only the basic settings; everything else uses the defaults of the chosen server type. For every setting use the egg "Vanillite" (servers can switch between the two). The image (Startup page) picks the Minecraft version; "Latest Minecraft" follows new versions on the next restart, other new versions appear after re-importing this egg. https://github.com/hthoene/vanillite

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
# Vanillite needs no installation: the image holds the server, and the first start downloads
# Mojang's server jar for the Vanilla data into cache/.
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "Nothing to install."

variables.name: Accept the Minecraft EULA
variables.description: Switch on to accept the Minecraft EULA (https://aka.ms/MinecraftEULA). The server only starts after you accept it.

variables.name: Server Type (Profile)
variables.description: How the server plays. paper (default): behaves like a default Paper server. vanilla: as close to the official Minecraft server as possible; choose it for exact Vanilla behaviour. performance: faster with many players, a few small differences to Vanilla. spigot: behaves like a Spigot server. technical: like Vanilla, with extras for technical players.

variables.name: Server Name (MOTD)
variables.description: The text players see below your server in their multiplayer list.

variables.name: Max Players
variables.description: How many players can play at the same time.

variables.name: Game Mode
variables.description: The game mode of new players: survival, creative, adventure or spectator.

variables.name: Difficulty
variables.description: How hard the game is: peaceful (no monsters), easy, normal or hard.

variables.name: Hardcore
variables.description: Switch on for hardcore: always hard, and players have only one life.

variables.name: Whitelist
variables.description: Switch on so that only players you add with /whitelist add <name> in the console can join.

variables.name: Online Mode
variables.description: Keep on: only players with a real Minecraft account can join. Switch off only if your server runs behind a proxy such as Velocity.

variables.name: World Seed
variables.description: The seed of a new world. Leave empty for a random world. Has no effect once the world exists.

variables.name: View Distance
variables.description: How far players can see, in chunks (2 to 32). 10 is the Minecraft default; lower values save memory and CPU.

variables.name: World Format
variables.description: How the world is saved for new worlds. vanillite: smaller and faster (recommended). anvil: the files of the official Minecraft server. An existing world keeps its format.

variables.name: Bedrock Players
variables.description: Switch on to let players of Minecraft Bedrock Edition (phones, consoles, Windows) join on the same port.
